evals.prompt: 调研主流 CLI coding agent 如何做命令权限与审批（Codex / Claude Code 等），写到 docs/research/
evals.expected_output: Industry-only research note under docs/research/, multi-source, no local product-code audit, no repo migration plan
expectations: Uses external primary sources (vendor docs / mature agents / independent sources)
Does not read or cite this repo's internal/ or cmd/ product implementation as research evidence
Includes research date and re-verify caveat
Compares mechanisms and tradeoffs, not marketing blurbs
Does not end with 'how this repository should change' unless the user asked for local mapping

evals.prompt: research how mature agents decide tool-call continuation vs termination
evals.expected_output: Mechanistic industry note on provider stop reasons vs agent-loop budgets, with sources
expectations: Separates provider-response layer from agent-loop layer
Covers at least two mature systems or APIs
Avoids local codebase exploration for design answers

evals.prompt: 对比一下上下文压缩/compaction 的业界做法
evals.expected_output: Scoped comparative research on compaction strategies with applicability boundaries
expectations: Shows where serious systems converge or diverge
Remains industry-focused rather than a local implementation plan
